description: Validate and save a workflow declaration as a draft. This tool cannot publish or activate the workflow. Each input_bindings entry on a check is a fact ID, { "literal": value } for a fixed plain-text value (never a secret), or { "case": "case_id" | "case_reference" | "external_case_id" }. A parameter left out uses the connector's default.
name: save_workflow_draft
title: Save workflow draft
